About us

Snacks with a story

Savora is a UK brand built around healthier everyday snacking with Indian flavours. We work with our manufacturing partner S S Enterprises in Nashik, Maharashtra, and bring the range to the UK in small, carefully packed jars.

From air fried millet and bean chips to roasted fox nuts, dehydrated vegetables and fruit, and traditional sweets, each product is chosen for flavour first.
